newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 21.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 44.95 points higher at 6,703.55 on strong corporate earnings.
* Japan will ask the World Trade Organisation (WTO) to create a panel to rule on its complaint over Indonesia's car policy, a Trade Ministry official said on Friday.
* Indonesian President Suharto has told villagers in Central Java he is healthy even though he is 75 years old, the official Antara news agency reported last week.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.78 points to close at 637.59 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,410.50/11.25 at 020 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,410.50/11.50.
* Tin miner Timah on a newspaper report it had cancelled a plan to acquire Australian mining firm Ross Mining which has operations in Papua New Guinea.
* Shipping firm Soedarpo on an announcement that state-owned financial firm PT Danareksa planned to acquire a 51-percent stake in Soedarpo.
* Retailers Multipolar and Matahari after news that Matahari president director Hari Dharmawan in his personal capacity has bought a 10-percent stake in Multipolar.
